attributes.content:
**EL-BEAM-1.4.1 Cluster high-beam telltale**

DIM_Lighting shall light Cluster_HighBeamTelltale while LeftHighBeamLightRequest or RightHighBeamLightRequest is 1, as received in each HighBeamLightControl frame.

description: Obligation of DIM_Lighting as DIM in LightingIndication (EL-BEAM-1.4.1).
DIM is a supplier cluster; its realization ImplementedDIM_Lighting is body_can.dbc, which lists DIM as receiver of HighBeamLightControl.
